angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 783,908 km at 67.95 pc = 0.15 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 14.7174 +/- 0.0148 mas (same row, RUWE 1.11): 67.95 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.127 (1.104 to 1.149) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 783,908 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.968 (0.928 to 1.008) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5728 +/- 1.2 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1692267077979468544: teff_gspphot 5727.5093 K (16th-84th percentiles 5726.456-5728.7827), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1692267077979468544: teff_gspphot 5727.5093 K (16th-84th percentiles 5726.456-5728.7827), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/funi.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.320, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 109246 (pscomppars): spectral type G0 V, from Boisse et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A%26A...523A..88B/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 109246 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.1 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 109246 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.10028, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 1692267077979468544, flags_flame 00: age_flame 9.370943 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 8.267419 to 10.474457)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 109246 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3 km/s, from Boisse et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A%26A...523A..88B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
